findings.description: An AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded directly in Lambda environment variables. This exposes credential material through Terraform source/state and to principals able to read the function configuration; use a scoped IAM role or a secret reference instead.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security fixes. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
